title: Four slices are heading for master
paras: Master is green. Four slices have pull requests into master: the blueprint's stage 2b, the speed lane's first landing, telemetry, and the api moved to Europe.
Each merges once its full run passes. The docs slice is waiting on its full run too.

title: The run-time plan is agreed
paras: The plan to get a full run under five minutes is merged, with your decisions in it.
The speed lane builds it now, plumbing first. Today a full run takes twenty-seven minutes; the plan projects four and a half to five and a half.

title: Blueprint stage 2a landed
paras: The whole blueprint moved into its new layout, and every journey still passes.
It went through the checks, a full run and an independent review before merging. Stage 2b is next.

title: The plan grew
paras: After the blueprint restack, the foundations milestone grew to eleven steps.
Forty-six units of work were added to the plan today. That is why the burn-down jumps back up.

title: Five foundation steps proven
paras: Generated files, the seeded chain, the lint ratchet, machines and the delta check are all proven on master.
Five of the foundations milestone's eleven steps are done.
